checked_by: project owner (git user jiaowh), interactive LTspice window
purpose: G1 adoption gate: the batch adapter reproduces an interactive (GUI) run of the same bench

bench.description: EPC2204 RDS(on) operating point: VGS = 5 V, 16 A into the drain, 25 C, reltol 1e-6

comparison_rule: every value shown in the GUI operating-point window equals the batch value rounded to the GUI's 6 significant figures
limits: One operating-point bench. Transient and AC analyses were not compared in the GUI; they are covered by the batch known-answer fixtures.
